components.css: .ds-lineup{font-family:'Archivo Variable',system-ui,sans-serif;list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0 16px;background:var(--paper,#f2f0ea);color:var(--ink,#111111);} .ds-row{display:grid;grid-template-columns:22px 42px minmax(0,1fr);column-gap:8px;padding:10px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--toner-3,#c9c6bd);} .ds-row-tick{margin-top:4px;width:16px;height:16px;display:grid;place-content:center;border-radius:4px;background:var(--ink,#111111);color:var(--paper,#f2f0ea);} .ds-row-time{padding-top:2px;font-size:12px;font-weight:600;color:var(--toner-2,#66655f);font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;} .ds-row-body{min-width:0;} .ds-row-top{display:flex;align-items:baseline;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;} .ds-row-artist{font-size:13px;font-weight:600;color:var(--toner-1,#3a3a37);} .ds-row-status{font-size:13px;font-weight:700;} .ds-miss{color:var(--miss,#c41f17);} .ds-row-title{font-size:23px;line-height:1.08;font-weight:900;font-stretch:64%;} .ds-row-links{margin:4px 0 0;display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;column-gap:12px;font-size:12px;font-weight:500;} .ds-row-links a{color:inherit;text-decoration:underline;text-decoration-color:var(--toner-3,#c9c6bd);text-underline-offset:3px;} .ds-row-links a:hover{text-decoration-color:var(--ink,#111111);} .ds-row-links a:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--focus,#111111);outline-offset:2px;} .ds-highlighter{background-image:linear-gradient(transparent 16%,var(--highlight,#f4ff3a) 16%,var(--highlight,#f4ff3a) 88%,transparent 88%);background-repeat:no-repeat;background-size:100% 100%;color:#111111;box-decoration-break:clone;-webkit-box-decoration-break:clone;padding:0 2px;margin:0 -2px;animation:ds-swipe 420ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1);} @keyframes ds-swipe{from{background-size:0% 100%;}} @media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-highlighter{animation:none;}}

narrative.overview:
The side panel reads like a flyer pasted on a club wall: toner black on off-white paper, one band of Day-Glo pink across the top, and the lineup set in heavy condensed type. The tracklist is billed the way a promoter bills a lineup. Tracks confirmed by more than one clip are set large and narrow; tracks heard only once drop to a small "Plus N unconfirmed" line beneath them. When a track lands in the cart, a fluoro highlighter swipes across its name.

Density is high and flat. Everything sits on one sheet of paper, divided by plain rules: a fine toner hairline between rows, a heavy ink rule wherever the sheet changes job (status to lineup, lineup to footer, the "Plus" line). There are no cards, no shadows and no tinted panels. Dark mode is the same flyer printed on black stock: paper and ink swap, the toner ramp inverts, and the pink band, highlighter and on-colour ink stay exactly as they are.
keyCharacteristics: One self-hosted variable face, Archivo, worked across its width axis (62% to 100%) and weight (400 to 900); upright only.
Type size carries confidence: confirmed tracks are billed large, unconfirmed ones small.
Colour is semantic and scarce: pink is the header band, yellow means in your cart, red means a miss.
Structure comes from rules, never from containers or elevation.
Light paper and black stock follow the system colour scheme; no in-panel theme switch.

rules.name: The Highlighter Means Cart Rule
rules.body: Yellow appears only as the swipe on a carted track's name. Text selection is Light Toner, not yellow, so the mark never means anything else.

rules.name: The One Band Rule
rules.body: Pink is the header band. It never fills a button, colours text or tints a row. Its single other job is the focus ring on black stock, where ink would vanish.

rules.name: The Toner Only Rule
rules.body: Every neutral is paper, ink or one of the three toner steps. No other greys enter the panel.

rules.name: The Red Is a Miss Rule
rules.body: Red marks something that did not make it into the cart, or an error. It never decorates.

rules.name: The Billing Rule
rules.body: Confidence sets size. A confirmed track is Headline; an unconfirmed track is Title Small under the "Plus" line. Never bill an unconfirmed ID at headline size.

rules.name: The Narrow Names Rule
rules.body: Condensed widths (62% to 90%) belong to names and figures: the mix title, track names, the counter, the "Plus" line. Metadata, buttons and sentences stay at normal width.

rules.name: The Upright Only Rule
rules.body: No italic or oblique anywhere. Emphasis comes from weight, width and size. Labels and headings are sentence case.

rules.name: The Rules Not Boxes Rule
rules.body: Rows are separated by a 1px Light Toner hairline. Sections that change job are separated by a 2px ink rule. Content is never grouped into cards, tiles or tinted panels.

rules.name: The Photocopy Is Flat Rule
rules.body: A photocopier cannot print a shadow. Overlays get a 2px ink border; nothing gets box-shadow, glow or blur.

dos: **Do** bill confirmed tracks at Headline (900, 23px, width 64%) and unconfirmed ones at Title Small (600, 15px, width 90%) under a "Plus N unconfirmed" line.
**Do** separate rows with a 1px Light Toner hairline and sections with a 2px ink rule.
**Do** keep exactly one ink-filled primary button per state, in the status section.
**Do** use the 2px focus outline with 2px offset: ink on paper, pink on black stock.
**Do** keep On-Pink and On-Highlight text near-black (#111111) in both themes.
**Do** keep disabled checkboxes at full ink while a job runs.
donts: **Don't** use yellow for anything except the carted-track highlighter, including text selection.
**Don't** use pink outside the header band and the black-stock focus ring; pink on paper is under 3:1 (2.93:1), so it never carries text or focus there.
**Don't** add box-shadow, glow or blur to anything, menus included.
**Don't** group tracks or settings into cards, tiles or tinted panels.
**Don't** introduce greys outside the three toner steps.
**Don't** set italic or oblique type, all-caps labels, or a label above a heading.
